# PanePilot v0.5.0

PanePilot 0.5 adds a focused, read-only view of each project's Git state and reduces
durable storage of Codex's raw terminal stream.

## Highlights

- Open a Git pane from the focused project's toolbar to inspect repository status and
  history without leaving PanePilot.
- Distinguish conflicts, staged changes, working-tree modifications, untracked files,
  clean state, upstream ahead/behind counts, and stashes at a glance.
- Browse an all-branch commit graph with decorations, authors, timestamps, and bounded
  **Load older commits** pagination.
- Use the same read-only Git capability for local and SSH-backed projects. PanePilot
  disables optional Git locks for these reads and never stages, commits, or otherwise
  mutates the repository.
- Keep live Codex terminal replay in a bounded in-memory buffer instead of continuously
  persisting its raw terminal output to SQLite. Restart recovery continues to use the
  exact provider thread ID and Codex's own conversation archive.
- Preserve existing saved-output behavior for login shells, Claude Code, Actions, and
  other non-Codex terminal profiles.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First-launch note

This desktop build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After
copying PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and
confirm the launch. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this GitHub repository.
